abilities.name: Break Through
abilities.description: Once per round, when your Digimon makes an attack, you may spend 8 Hope to ignore the target's Attribute and Element matchup. For that attack, treat your Digimon as having the ideal matchup against the target.

abilities.name: Push Further
abilities.description: Break Through now costs 4 Hope instead of 8.

abilities.name: Cheer
abilities.description: When an ally fails a skill check, you may spend Hope equal to your rank in the Crest Stat used for that check. Add that amount to the ally's result. You may use Cheer after seeing the roll, but before the GM determines the outcome.

abilities.name: Everyone's Angle
abilities.description: Break Through can now be used when any allied Digimon makes an attack. You pay the Hope cost yourself.

abilities.name: Gatomon's Legacy
abilities.description: Your Digimon's Max Default Stage increases by 1 permanently. Their Default Stage can now reach one stage higher than the campaign maximum allowed for other Digimon. This cannot increase their Default Stage beyond Mega.

abilities.name: Light the Way
abilities.description: You can use Break Through on every attack. It is no longer limited to once per round.
